brief.zh: 每一拍交出总线上一拍的那一位；第一拍交出 1。
brief.en: Every tick, give out the bit the bus had the tick before; 1 on the first tick.

t.zh: 板每一拍从头跑，上一拍的东西它一样也记不住。可总线上的一位只有和前后连起来看才有意思。
t.en: The board starts afresh each tick and remembers nothing of the last one. Yet a bit on the bus only means something next to the bits around it.

t.zh: 探针多了一种能力：<wiki-ref to="register"></wiki-ref>。<part-ref to="part:keep"></part-ref>把这一拍接到它上面的值存起来，下一拍<part-ref to="part:reg"></part-ref>把它读出来；名字相同的两个元件说的是同一张寄存卡。读的那个可以设一个初值：还没存过东西时读出它。
t.en: The probe gains one ability: <wiki-ref to="register"></wiki-ref>s. <part-ref to="part:keep"></part-ref> stores the value wired into it this tick, and <part-ref to="part:reg"></part-ref> reads it back on the next one; two parts with the same name are the same register. The reading one has a start value: what it reads before anything is kept.

hint.zh: 这一拍的总线存起来，下一拍读出来交出去。
hint.en: Keep the bus this tick, and give out what you read next tick.

after.zh: 寄存卡把一拍和下一拍连了起来：从现在起，板能记事了。
after.en: A register ties one tick to the next: from now on the board can remember.
